summary: Eversource Energy filed an 8-K announcing the completed sale of its subsidiary Aquarion Water Company to Aquarion Water Authority, a Connecticut quasi-public entity, for $2.4 billion in cash. The sale was executed after satisfying all regulatory terms and requirements. Adjusted net equity proceeds of approximately $1.7 billion will be used to displace Eversource debt. The company expects a non-cash after-tax charge of ~$115 million ($0.31/share) in Q2 2026. No board recommendation, advisor, break fee, or premium was disclosed. The filing is a closing announcement, not a pending transaction. What to watch: the deployment of proceeds and any impact on credit ratings.
